Short answer

To install cliamp on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add cliamp. It is a 13.7 MB download (40.8 MB installed), version 2.3.0-3, licensed MIT. A retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp 2.x. Free and open source (MIT licensed, source available on GitHub).

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install cliamp on Omarchy

cliamp is a retro-styled music player that lives entirely in the terminal, built to evoke Winamp 2.x with a spectrum visualizer and a parametric EQ rendered in ASCII. It plays local files as well as internet radio, podcasts, and streams pulled from YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Spotify, Navidrome, Jellyfin, and more. Playlists, a Lua plugin system, and cross-platform support (Linux, macOS, Windows) round it out.

Watch: The Ultimate Terminal Music Player? Meet Cliamp. ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add cliamp
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2.3.0-3:
    pacman -Qi cliamp

Open and use cliamp

cliamp is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql cliamp | grep applications

cliamp requirements and compatibility

  • Network access to stream from services like YouTube, Spotify, or internet radio
  • ffmpeg and yt-dlp needed for extended codec and streaming-provider support
  • Linux needs ALSA dev headers and a PipeWire-ALSA or PulseAudio-ALSA bridge for audio

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • alsa-lib
  • flac
  • libvorbis
  • libogg
  • mpg123
  • ffmpeg
  • yt-dlp

Pricing and license

Free and open source (MIT licensed, source available on GitHub). License: MIT.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install cliamp on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add cliamp. The download is 13.7 MB and it takes 40.8 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is cliamp free?

Free and open source (MIT licensed, source available on GitHub). The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall cliamp?

Run omarchy pkg drop cliamp. It removes the package from your system.

What does cliamp depend on?

The package declares 7 dependencies: alsa-lib, flac, libvorbis, libogg, mpg123, ffmpeg, yt-dlp. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is cliamp a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for cliamp.

Is cliamp in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as cliamp (version 2.3.0-3) in the official Omarchy package repository. bjarneo makes it. Project site: https://github.com/bjarneo/cliamp. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
